name: agsglobalfarmsarl
description: Monorepo runner for the AGS Globalfarm web backend and mobile app. Each workspace keeps its own dependencies: web/ uses npm, mobile/ uses bun.

scripts.install:all: cd web && npm install && cd ../mobile && bun install
scripts.prebuild: cd mobile && npx expo prebuild --platform android
scripts.rebuild: cd mobile && npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean
scripts.apk: cd mobile && npx expo prebuild --platform android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.aab: cd mobile && npx expo prebuild --platform android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.eas:preview: cd mobile && npx eas build --profile preview --platform android
scripts.eas:prod: cd mobile && npx eas build --profile production --platform all
scripts.eas:submit: cd mobile && npx eas submit --profile production --platform all
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:mobile
scripts.format: cd web && npm run format && cd ../mobile && bun run format
